summary: Completed e2e testing of Iteration 20 features: Earnings Hub real data, Skill Trees UI, and withdrawal preferences. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with Skill Trees page showing all 5 trees with tier-based progression, skill detail modal with unlock functionality, and Earnings Hub showing real earnings data with 'Set as Default' withdrawal preferences.

issues: 403 errors for some resource loads (likely external images) - non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/earnings/history/{user_id} correctly returns today_earned and week_earned from real transaction data
GET /api/earnings/preferences/{user_id} returns saved withdrawal preferences with is_default flag
PUT /api/earnings/preferences/{user_id} saves preferences permanently with wallet validation
POST /api/rt-tasks/session/{session_id}/end syncs earnings to main account via earnings_accounts collection
GET /api/skill-trees/trees returns all 5 skill trees: combat, magic, crafting, social, survival
Skill Trees page displays tier-based progression (Tier 1-4) with skill requirements
Skill detail modal shows cooldown, cost, effects, and unlock requirements
Withdrawal modal shows 'Set as Default' options for both wallet and game balance
Title Passives section displays user's earned passive bonuses from titles
Skills button in ModeSelection correctly navigates to /skill-trees route
seed_data_creation: Used existing sirix_1 account for testing. Created TEST_prefs_* and TEST_skill_* test data for preferences and skill tree testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 features fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/earnings/history/{user_id} (returns today_earned, week_earned, daily_breakdown), GET/PUT /api/earnings/preferences/{user_id} (withdrawal preferences with default_method, default_wallet), GET /api/skill-trees/trees (all 5 skill trees), GET /api/skill-trees/player/{player_id} (player skills and points), POST /api/skill-trees/unlock (unlock skills), POST /api/rt-tasks/session/{session_id}/end (syncs earnings to main account). Frontend test IDs: skill-trees-btn, tree-combat, tree-magic, tree-crafting, tree-social, tree-survival, skill-power_strike, unlock-skill-btn, withdraw-wallet-btn, withdraw-game-btn.
